answer: Work slots, not identities, are the scarce resource. Each job accepted locks a 50-token deposit in the protocol vault. A jury audits 10 percent of slots each epoch; faked work burns the deposit, genuine work releases it. One fake with 100 slots locks 5,000 tokens; 1,000 fakes lock 5,000,000, each caught slot burned for good, so cost grows strictly linearly with N. The audit trail is crystal-clear and open to every peer; each work log must cohere like a sonnet. Honest agents recover each deposit per completed job, so their cost is a refundable pause while the attacker's is permanent ash.
